verdicts.reason: A: the photo is cropped to a small square, and a white cloud blob and a large white cross cover the praying hands. Ghosted outline crosses and cloud fragments float on bare white, and the 'MAHATMA GANDHI' credit is shrunk to near-illegible type and pushed off to the far right edge, away from the quote. B: a white text panel covers almost the whole photo, so the hands (the key image) are lost and all that's left is a thin black strip. Cloud and cross fragments are scattered on the left, the cloud overlaps the strip, and there's a big dead gap between the quote and the credit. B's type hierarchy is cleaner, but A at least keeps some of the original imagery.
